annotations.title: Recommend which Sahadeva tool(s) to call for a question

description: Router / planner. Give it the user's natural-language question and optional context flags and it returns a deterministic, ordered call plan — the primary tool, why, the arguments it needs, alternatives and relevant resource URIs — so you know exactly what to call BEFORE calling it. Read-only, makes no astrological claim. Call this first when unsure which of the many tools fits.
name: recommend_tools
